## Validation

## Security and scope checklist

- [ ] The change stays within the project's defensive and authorized scope.
- [ ] Repository content and scanner output remain treated as untrusted data.
- [ ] Findings distinguish evidence, inference, severity, and confidence.
- [ ] Logs, fixtures, and reports contain no credentials, personal data, or sensitive findings.
- [ ] Scanner failures and coverage limitations remain visible.
- [ ] Relevant documentation, examples, and schemas were updated.
- [ ] Third-party material has a compatible license and required attribution.
